response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, total_games, total_games * 1.0 / SUM(total_games) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, total_games * 1.0 / AVG(total_games) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Teams are grouped by team_id alone, combining all years and leagues. Teams whose games are all NULL stay in the result with a NULL total, and they are still counted in the average across teams.
Fractions use floating-point division (multiplying by 1.0) to avoid integer truncation.
